identity.name: SignalRanking
identity.mission: To build the world's most accurate forecasting record.
identity.aesthetic: The 'Bloomberg Terminal' meets 'Linear'. High data density, low visual noise. Structure over decoration.

weights.headings: 600 (SemiBold) or 500 (Medium) - Avoid Black/Bold to keep it clean

typography.instructions: Use Manrope for all section headers and major titles. Use Inter for all paragraphs and UI labels. Use JetBrains Mono for ALL data points (percentages, scores, dates) to emphasize the analytical nature.

usage_rules.backgrounds: Main dashboard background should be 'bg-slate-50' (#F8FAFC) to differentiate from white cards.
usage_rules.cards: Cards must be White (#FFFFFF) with a 1px border (#E2E8F0). NO SHADOWS by default. Hover state: border-blue-200.
usage_rules.text: Never use pure black. Use Slate-900 (#0F172A) for headings and Slate-500 (#64748B) for secondary text.
usage_rules.gradients: FORBIDDEN. Use solid colors only. Exception: Very subtle mesh gradients in the Hero section background (opacity 5%).

visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-md (6px) or rounded-sm (4px). Avoid fully rounded 'pill' shapes for containers.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Avoid drop shadows. Use borders to define hierarchy. If shadow is needed for dropdowns, use 'shadow-lg ring-1 ring-black/5'.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle 'noise' overlay allowed on the Landing Page hero section only.
visual_enhancers.icons: Lucide React (default). Use thin strokes (1.5px) to match the precision vibe.

dashboard.structure: Sidebar Navigation (Left, Fixed) + Main Content Area (Right, Scrollable).
dashboard.grid: Bento Grid for the 'Overview' page. 3-column grid for 'Questions List'.
dashboard.spacing: Compact but breathable. Gap-4 for data grids, Gap-8 for section separation.

landing_page.hero: Split layout: Left Text (Value Prop) + Right Visual (Abstract Data/Platform Preview).
landing_page.features: Zig-zag layout or 3-column grid with icons.

buttons.primary: bg-blue-900 text-white hover:bg-blue-800 rounded-md font-medium px-6 py-2.5 transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-md font-medium px-6 py-2.5

inputs.style: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-md px-3 py-2 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 focus:border-blue-500 transition-all

placeholders.chart_placeholder: Use Recharts for actual data visualization. Do not use static images for charts.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA standards. Blue-900 on White is safe. Slate-500 on White is borderline - check size.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus rings are MANDATORY. Use 'focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-blue-500'.
accessibility.aria: All interactive elements must have aria-labels if they don't have visible text.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL DEPENDENCIES: npm install lucide-react recharts framer-motion clsx tailwind-merge
2. SETUP FONTS: Add Manrope and JetBrains Mono to the project (via Google Fonts in index.html or CSS import).
3. OVERRIDE SHADCN: Modify the default Shadcn 'radius' in tailwind.config.js to '0.375rem' (6px).
4. CREATE LAYOUTS: Build a 'DashboardLayout' component with a fixed sidebar and a 'MarketingLayout' for the landing page.
5. DATA VIZ: Use Recharts for the 'Accuracy History' and 'Prediction Probability' charts.
6. AUTH PAGES: Keep them dead simple. Centered card on a slate-50 background.
7. DO NOT use gradients for buttons or backgrounds. Keep it flat and professional.
8. USE 'data-testid' on all buttons, inputs, and links.
universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) sparingly (only for sticky headers).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc for icons.
